text:
The program is already careful about open claims. This page makes that operational. It does not add physics. It restates, for each open item, what would count as progress and what would count as failure — and, for restricted finite results, the intended scope so a later post cannot quietly generalize them.

Pretty predicate ≠ pass. v15.99 can look true and still be INVALID. The meter outranks the predicate.
Completeness ≠ law. v16.36 certified the canonical 18-pair set. Gate D stays UNRESOLVED. A complete record is not a source law.
Barrier ≠ metric. v16.35 barriers are combinatorial. They are not distances, energies, or time.
Bounded unit ≠ universal law. v16.37 and v16.38 found no nonunit pair inside n≤6. v16.39 SC is sufficient, not a characterization.
Family theorem ≠ one graph, and ≠ every tree. v16.45 covers arbitrary leaf degrees in its stated domain. It does not cover chains or arbitrary retained trees.
Height 1 ≠ small ambiguity, and ≠ one move. A packed star m=k=q has m! exact components at barrier 1. The repair can be a long sequence whose maximum excursion is 1.
Uniform height ≠ a no-go. It rules out a source that depends only on barrier height. It does not prove the retained structure cannot contribute. The chain induction explains the bound inside chains. It does not select P.
v16.50 is an existence theorem for one suitable sequence on full binary trees. The bound is the total excursion, not each coordinate. The 1920 cases are not a census. Full binary does not mean balanced.
Do not call the barrier merely a uniform tax. Palette width can grow, by max(a,b) or a+b, while the peak departure stays 1.
The three-child question was run as v16.51, one ternary root, not a nonunit witness. v16.52 repeats ternary composition. v16.53 stops at arity 4. v16.54 is floor two only. v16.55 is a bounded guard, not a universal root repair.
A11.X60 is a colored-carrier checkpoint. It is not universal arbitrary-root minimum repair. A three-cover bound on minimum paths in one control is not an obstruction to every temporary incidence.
A11.X61 is a sufficient batch interface. It is not three-cover necessity and not a universal existence certificate. X62, X63, and X64 have no closeout.
A12.1–A12.5 is not numbered v16 certification and not physical validation. The stronger graph-descriptor impossibility is withdrawn as unproved, not declared false. The A12.5 no-go does not exclude every locality notion.
Post-A12 scoped proofs at 6a99418 named auxiliary cycle breaking as the next line. The 10 Oct tip does not publish a closeout under that name and does not keep it as the frontier. A temporary auxiliary incidence is not a physical primitive. No A12.6.
Spare capacity is not reachable reserve. A non-isolated local-progress obstruction is not a general impossibility. Static feasibility is not connectivity.
Universal core region means the declared tau 3 to 4 hidden-completion test. It is not general connectivity and not observer access.
Scoped C3 repair is not broad C3 and not guaranteed progress. Count reconstructions do not derive field access. Safe core writes do not initialize the hidden record.
An archived Gemini acceptance is not peer review, not numbered v16 certification, and not a STATUS bump.

Failure: teaching v15.99 INVALID as a confirmation. Failure: teaching v16.13F as Einstein or as derived quantum mechanics. The obstruction composition stays underdetermined. Failure: teaching v16.35 barriers as a metric, an energy, or time. Failure: teaching v16.36 Gate D UNRESOLVED as LOCAL_UNIT, or the closed 18-pair audit as a predictive barrier law. The old signature uses an already computed barrier. An independent construction can still explain the bound. Failure: teaching PR #81 as a merge to main. Failure: reading barrier height 1 as “the profile almost determines the component,” or as one move. Failure: reading a uniform unit bound as proof that the retained structure cannot contribute to a source. Failure: dismissing v16.48 because an older README says PRE-CLOSURE. The integration-branch closure is chains only. Failure: teaching v16.49 as arbitrary trees, or scoring unit as failure and nonunit as success. Failure: teaching v16.50 as every path, as a short path, as a balanced-only theorem, or as a mere uniform tax. Failure: teaching the 1920 directed cases as a census. Failure: teaching a three-child overlap example as a nonunit witness, or a failed normalization as a certified barrier. Failure: teaching A11.X60 as universal arbitrary-root repair. Failure: teaching A11.X61 as three-cover necessity, or X62–X64 as closed. Failure: teaching the A12 closeout as numbered v16 certification, as physical validation, or as proof that a response graph cannot describe a state. That stronger sentence was withdrawn as unproved, not declared false. Failure: teaching auxiliary cycle breaking as finished, or a temporary auxiliary incidence as a physical primitive. None of v15.75–v16.55, and not the overlapping-guard branch, is merged to main. Supported four unchanged.

Post-QRSL branch reassessment / metric-affine continuum evidence. Which Pillar-3 claims survive without an ontology-native coarse-to-fine section. Do not add a refinement axiom to unlock RATS. RATS remains sealed / unexecuted. Pillar 3 / Einstein remains OPEN. Not a gravity derivation. Live board: /wiki/september-2026-ladder. Evidence: GitHub STATUS.md (no X URL).

Supported harnesses have numeric targets on the proofs page. Open items have progress/failure tests here. Restricted results name the family, the graph size, or the sector they actually cover.
